However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart arrives in search of renegade Indians suspected of the murder of a Texas Ranger.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Sid Fallon tries to blackmail a former gambler into allowing him to use her boarding house as a gambling hall.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas puts his life in jeopardy when he agrees to testify in a murder case where the first witness was killed before he could testify, and the killer is still at large.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas welcomes his old friend Tom Birch, unaware that the man is now a bank robber on the run with his gang.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Dan Maury, released from Yuma prison, arrives in North Fork intent on getting even with Marshal Torrance, who helped send him to jail.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark McCain is eager to help lawman Jay Jefferson, who has arrived in town to kill an outlaw for the reward.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas comes to the rescue when escaped convicts hold up the general store in North Fork and take Marshall Torrance hostage.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Young Mark manages to capture a hawk but falls into danger with a rattlesnake. A stranger comes to his rescue and Mark invites the man home, unaware that he is on the run from the law.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The McCains try to be tolerant of their embittered neighbor Abel MacDonald, but they decide he's gone too far when he won't allow his injured boy to get medical treatment.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An unfounded rumor causes North Fork's outspoken feminist schoolteacher to be attacked by a mob of angry townspeople.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When his employer begins to suspect him of embezzlement, Asa Manning decides to hire a professional gunman.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A drought has forced local cowhands to seek work on a railroad construction project, but executives are afraid workers will desert them if they believe an old man's claim of making rain.

programme.desc: When renegade Apaches wound Lucas, Marshall Torrance joins with a U.S. Marshall to form a rescue posse.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Living Dark: The Story of Ted the Caver
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers become obsessed with gaining access to an unexplored cave, despite the horrors they encounter during their excavation.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. Instead, they find a 50-foot boa constrictor.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Hell Night
programme.desc: Four college pledges are forced to spend the night in a deserted old mansion, where they are stalked by the monstrous survivor of a family massacre years earlier.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. programme.desc: As Tommy and Peyton resume work on their 1966 Chevy Nova, they suddenly learn that this project may go from Starstruck to Struck Out. With that, they switch gears into another historic muscle car, 1969 Pontiac GTO.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Adding Brakes, Wheels, and Tires is cool, but mechanical and electrical systems have to get buttoned up to revive this 80's lady! Is it finally time to fire up this '85 Buick?

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our 1969 Pontiac GTO, Project Henchman, needs to bulk up before breaking out, so Tommy and Peyton are using the time to modify the chassis and install new fuel lines on this tough prisoner.

programme.desc: The Carcass Crew fabricates heavy duty bumpers and rock sliders to help protect their Overlanding Toyota 4Runner on the trails.

programme.title: Engine Power

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: The open-wheel Modified receives a high-compression, high-revving Chevy small block.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We seek more power from our twin-engine dyno setup, by reconfiguring the exhaust and phasing the 496 Big Block Chevy engines. Plus we head to Texas to check out SAM Tech's engine program!
programme.sub-title: Phasing Twin Big Blocks For More Power

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel visit a museum in a Lane of its own to see some one-of-a-kind vehicles. Then, they head over to the track to put the pedal to the metal on their '83 Hurst Olds retro rocket!
programme.sub-title: Dropping the Hammer On The Retro Rocket Hurst Olds - Part 5

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: The '65 C10's patina meets a pearl that you just have to see! Plus it gets a locking differential conversion.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: It's a blast from the past when project Fast Lane finally sings. This 1990 Fox Body Mustang embraces the time period it came from and rides off into the wavy sunset.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We finally found a home for our 509 cubic inch W-Series Big Block: A 1956 Chevrolet 210. We start with a frame and a body, and we immediately get to work on getting our high-performance powertrain fitted up.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: See if your top ten muscle car list matches ours as we count down our favorite American Muscle Cars.

programme.title: Blacktop Speed Shop
programme.desc: Balling on a budget means spending your money wisely. Brian and Jason ordered a complete body kit for their 2011 Lexus IS 250 from China and today, they're cracking open the crate! Will it work or do they have to cut it to fit?

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Budgets spent and trucks built, the Ford and Ram go head to head to compare baseline numbers with those after all upgrades. Who will win? Austin's Eco, or LT's Viper.
programme.sub-title: Who Wins Dyno Test? V10 SRT10 or Twin-Turbo V6 F150?

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: There's no better place for the test sled's first pass on the strip than LS Fest in Bowling Green, KY!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Drag Strip Swap - Tommy and Joel elevate the curb appeal of an old 1967 Chevy Nova race car, showing you how to swap out some shiny stuff, which includes new bumpers and trim, as well as beef up the fire suppression system to get it looking cool and staying cool.

programme.title: Dirt & Trails
programme.desc: It's finally time to finish Project Spartan's drivetrain. We fabricate a new cross member, build custom mounting brackets, and install the transfer case on our 1969 M715 Jeep Kaiser. Then we modify the frame to accommodate the driveshaft run and tackle the suspension work needed to get the axles ready to be mounted. Project Spartan is getting closer to being a fully functioning machine.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We're stepping out of our comfort zone and building the ultimate dual-purpose pickup, a 2025 Nissan Frontier that we've nicknamed Trailgater. Eric and Joel modify a brand-new Nissan and turn it into the ultimate tailgating truck that would make any sports fan or overlander envious and excited.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We yank out our old suspension, upgrade the underside of our Diesel Dually, Nightshift, and give it a disc brake conversion and lift kit to help uphold its Dodge signature style.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We start with a Gen IV Iron Block 5.3L from the junkyard, get it running, and then add a selection of budget-friendly upgrades to turn it into a solid street swap engine. Afterward, we test our upgrades on the dyno and get a special visit from a high horsepower, big boost drag car.

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: Complete coverage of the second annual LS Fest West from Las Vegas Motor Speedway!

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our Granada has plenty of Seventies Style, but precious little power. This sounds like a good candidate for a sleeper build!
programme.sub-title: Disguising a High Revving 347 for our Sleeper Granada

programme.title: PowerNation on the Road
programme.desc: Watch the three year journey of a 1969 Dodge Charger from barn find to crossing the block at Mecum Auctions in Dallas. Detroit Muscle's Marc Christ and Tommy Boshers complete the restoration that results in a $200,000 sale number at auction!
programme.sub-title: Hellcat '69 Charger Restomod Sold For $200,000 - How We Did It

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle team goes all in to reveal their supercharged ground-pounding pony at SEMA 2021 in Vegas.
programme.sub-title: Time for our Supercharged EBC Mustang To Burn Rubber at the Track

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: The six-cylinder Ford's dyno numbers keep climbing as we give it major cam, piston, and cylinder head upgrades.
programme.sub-title: Full-Tilt Build On Our Ford 300 Inline 6 For Serious Power Gains

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Project Henchman is hoping to get a new look on this episode of Detroit Muscle. Tommy and Peyton begin rust repair and a new paint job that'll make this '69 Pontiac GTO shine.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We complete our stroker LS powerplant and put it to the ultimate performance test in the dyno cell!

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Will the EcoBoost's larger turbos and a high flow exhaust mean bigger improvements over the Viper's top end mods? Let the build-up begin!
programme.sub-title: Ram SRT-10 and F150 Get Engine Mods: Muscle Trux Build-Off: Drivetrain

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Does a '15 F150 Ford EcoBoost stand a chance against a '05 Dodge Ram SRT-10? It's a head-to-head build-off that starts with a track and dyno baseline. Let the tear down begin!
programme.sub-title: Ford F150 EcoBoost vs Dodge Ram SRT-10: Muscle Trux Build-Off

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We build a 632 big block Chevy to power an unusual hot rod project for the Carcass shop.
programme.sub-title: A 632 Big Block Chevy Is the Perfect Fit For This '77 Tow Truck Sleeper

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass crew gives you some tips on how to repair rusty trouble spots and remove dents on your project. Then we'll walk you through getting it ready for primer.
programme.sub-title: Repairing An Abandoned Chevy Silverado - Part 1

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our 445 FE is back, a modern EFI system, along with a time-tested tunnel wedge intake made for drivability.
programme.sub-title: Junkyard Ford 445 FE Gets Modern EFI

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Rust Revival - Brian and Joel are back in the shop with their sleeves rolled up and ready to bust the rust in their Chevy 210, Project Shell Shock. Watch as they cut, fit, and weld fresh floor pans into place, to help give this classic a solid foundation inside and out. Then it's full steam ahead as the guys strip Shell Shock down to bare metal, prepping every inch for a new paint job.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We have a new project that has a unique lineage in the motorsports world. We bring in a Datsun 280Z and take a look at how it handles on the road and how much power the 2.8 liter makes before we start stripping it down to begin our heritage transformation. Plus, we'll check out the future of automotive innovation at an electrifying event.
programme.sub-title: Starting Our 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod Build

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: It's prime time! Our Dodge Dually, Project Nightshift, will shed its skin today as we buzz off all the imperfections and repair the bumps and bruises you'd expect to find on a 31-year-old diesel truck. And if you're a true gearhead, get ready for a deep dive on how to calculate for your rear axle regear.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Our '96 Chevy Silverado gets new body parts. Plus we'll prep it for paint and show you how we are restoring the original color before hitting the road.
programme.sub-title: Restoring The Abandoned Chevy Silverado Paint Back To Its Former Glory

programme.title: HorsePower
programme.desc: Part 2 of HorsePower's dual Ford 351 project, as the guys complete the build of a Cleveland engine and then turn their attention to the Windsor engine. Using some original parts and aftermarket heads and intake, the guys transform the Windsor into a better-performing Clevor (or mock Cleveland).
programme.sub-title: 351 Small Block Dyno Shootout: Windsor vs Cleveland

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make 1000 Horsepower starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.
programme.sub-title: How to Build a 1000HP Diesel Beast

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Even in our most urban settings, pretty much all of us know squirrels. They can be divisive charac-ters; some people adore them, offering them food, while others see them as glorified rats. But we can all agree that these are speedy, quirky, and exceptional characters. They also go crazy for nuts. They've conquered most of the globe, from icy tundra to the hottest deserts, developing ingen-ious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: The Lion, Africa's ultimate predator. An essay in power and agility, famed for the cut-throat gang and the killer instinct. Lions are known as the kings of the jungle yet their homeland is an open grassland rather than rainforest. In the African plains prey-rich real estate can be hard to come by, and lions work together to ensure no one claims their territory and usurps their crown.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Lions, Chimpanzees, Turtles, Roe Deer, Gannets Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older?

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying like a teardrop in the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is an island that defies convention. Poised just six degrees above the equator, it's less than 75,000 km sq in size. But it has enough wildlife to rival a continent, and it's all down to its complicated climate and geography.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: In Anchorage, one bird rules the roost...the Bald Eagle. Expert hunters, they are perfectly adapted to life in tough arctic conditions, but in Anchorage, the secret to their survival... is trash. Every day, hundreds of bald eagles gather at the city dump, dodging trucks, machinery, and even pyrotechnics, in search of an easy meal. But this city life also brings constant danger, for the eagles themselves, and also for the human residents.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: In the middle of Colombia, lies an ancient, unique and little explored outcrop of sandstone; the Serrania de la Macarena. It forms part of the country's first ever national park - made up of lush jungle, shrubland and savannah, isolated peaks, winding rivers and spectacular waterfalls - where more than 15 million specimens were collected during early studies of the area. Called the 'treasure of the world', scientists believe it is a hugely important bank of biological diversity.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. Limited Rights Available: Worldwide, Free TV Only

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Destination Wild - India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: After pulling a bank heist in Mexico, the outlaw Rio (Marlon Brando) and his partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), make a run for it, but Dad has bigger plans than freedom. He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Delivery man Leo Jackson (Donald Faison) is definitely on the wrong road to success. He still lives at home, he and his girlfriend just broke up, and he has multiple complaints stacked against him at work. Fortunately, Leo has plenty of marijuana to keep his mind off his troubles. But when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address, Leo finds himself in the middle of a bad deal that may just cost him his life.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: The Last Letter
programme.desc: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Grow Old Along With Me
programme.desc: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Forbes (Carl Weathers) link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: Soldier Boyz
programme.desc: Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Will they work together, or allow their rivalries to consume them?

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In 72 hours a meteor will collide with Earth and annihilate mankind. Singapore's government tells its citizens to let loose for once and do absolutely anything they please.

programme.title: Armed Response
programme.desc: Trained operatives find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound after its artificial intelligence is suddenly shut down. There, they begin to experience strange and horrific phenomena.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Soul Men

Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: Sprung
programme.desc: Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage.

programme.desc: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life.

programme.desc: A policeman (Mario Van Peebles) learns that the CIA saved a deranged killer from execution to use as a government assassin.

programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.desc: Detective Andrea Oya and FBI agent Samantha Curry team up and hunt down a serial killer to solve a string of murders targeting Black women and Black children.

programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.desc: Mobster Frank (Chazz Palminteri) hires hip DJ Darrell (Usher) to man the turntables at a party for his gorgeous daughter, Dolly (Emmanuelle Chriqui). At the event, some crooks pull guns on the gangster, and Darrell steps in to save his life. Frank then gives the DJ a job as his daughter's bodyguard, but, to the mobster's dismay, Dolly starts to fall for the smooth-talking Darrell. Their romance is interrupted when Frank gets involved in a mob war and drags Darrell along with him.

programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits the birthplace of Mexico's most famous spirit, the town of Tequila. Back home Pati makes a brunch of corn tortilla egg nests with salsa verde con chile de árbol and traditional arroz rojo.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.
programme.sub-title: An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.
programme.sub-title: A Mayan League of their Own

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.
programme.sub-title: Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.
programme.sub-title: Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.

programme.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury
programme.desc: Stalingrad breaks the Nazi advance; Japan falters at Guadalcanal. The tide begins to turn. Mussolini falls as Allies land in Sicily. The Soviets crush Germany at Kursk. Allied tech improves-radar, codebreaking, bombing raids. War spreads into the skies. In Tehran, Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin prepare for D-Day. The drive to defeat fascism gathers momentum.

programme.title: Exploring Hitler's Berlin/Munich
programme.desc: Munich was closely tied to National Socialism, where the Nazi movement, SA, and SS were founded. Hitler called it the 'capital of the movement' and planned grandiose architectural projects. Though most plans weren't realized, landmarks like the 'Haus der Kunst' and parts of the party district still stand today. Rare footage shows Hitler visiting construction sites in Munich's transformed areas.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Reconnaissance Aircraft
programme.desc: Reconnaissance aircraft play a significant role in both war and peace time. This program looks at several planes that were deployed in this crucial activity including the RA-5C, the Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird, PC3 Orion and the Grumman E-2 Hawkeye.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: The Alps Front, June 1940. A handful of French soldiers are about to face a flood of 300,000 Italians. Everywhere in France, you see defeat. The Government fled to Bordeaux on June 14th. While France is breaking down, General Olry and his men remain stationed on the Alps. During ten days of fierce battle, the Italians will lose more than 6,000 men without seizing an inch of French territory.

programme.title: Weapons of War: Combat on the Russian Front
programme.desc: Documentary charting the battles waged on the Russian Front in the Second World War. The events which occurred are seen by some as the most barbaric conflict in human history

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: When Winston Churchill becomes Prime Minister of the wartime coalition government in May 1940, he pledges his blood, toil, tears and sweat; within days of his appointment, he is made to honor his promise; with France near defeat and Allied soldiers trapped at Dunkirk, Churchill faces a critical challenge; capturing the drama and resilience that defined his leadership during Britain's darkest hour.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With mainland Europe under Hitler's control, the German Fuhrer turned his attention to Operation Sealion, and the Battle of Britain. However he'd underestimated the enormity of the task and the spirit of a nation inspired by Winston Churchill.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The processing of plasma and penicillin. Troops in Normandy receive medical care. Naval guns bombard Cherbourg. The 8th and 9th Air Forces bomb communication lines. British troops take Caen. Shows Gen. Montgomery.
programme.sub-title: First Aid and the Taking of Cherbourg

programme.title: Military Legends of World War II
programme.desc: True stories of the Medal of Honor, the highest award for valor which can be bestowed upon an individual serving in the Armed Services of the United States.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Marine patrol action in Vietnam. Sequences show land and river patrols and a successful attack on a Viet Cong village. Emphasizes the importance of patrol action in maintaining contact with an elusive enemy.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: World War II at sea was marked by the rise of submarines, leading to fierce battles above and below the waves. Crews faced overcrowding and claustrophobia in these confined spaces. This technological evolution paved the way for modern submarines. Developed by Germany, submarines became as crucial to naval warfare as strategic bombers were to the skies, with other countries soon following suit.

programme.title: Vichy and the Nazis: A Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: 1942: Almost 80,000 French Jews are arrested, following the orders of Adolf Hitler and Vichy. From the Vel' d'Hiv Roundup to Auschwitz, thanks to the most recent historiography and reenactment, plunge into the making of the Holocaust.

programme.title: Hitler's Propaganda Machine
programme.desc: As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war - to be fought on many battlefields, and for the hearts and minds of the people.

programme.title: Nazi War Criminals
programme.desc: Nazi war criminals are put on trial for their war crimes committed during WWII. This program covers various events from the Lublin Massacre, German atrocities in concentration camps and many others
programme.sub-title: NEWSREEL FOOTAGE OF THE NAZI WAR CRIMINALS

programme.title: Visions of War: The Korean War
programme.desc: Covers the United States involvement with Korea and testing of Korean weapons. John Ford directed this film which is the only color documentary made during the Korean War.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: Japanese bombing of Pearl Harbor brings America to war.
programme.sub-title: America Goes to War in the Pacific

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at U.S. and British interests in the Pacific prior to World War II including Alaska, Hawaii, Guam, Australia, and New Zealand. It also looks at developments in Siam, China, and Japan focusing on the growth of modernization and militarism in Japan prior to the war.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: For nearly five years, Hitler's Third Reich has dominated Europe. Germany braces for an Allied invasion, fortifying the Atlantic Wall with steel, concrete, and advanced weaponry. Led by the USA, a global alliance faces overwhelming odds, launching a massive military assault to break Germany's grip on Western Europe and reclaim freedom from Nazi control.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: The history of armed conflict is intrinsically tied to the history of civilization and Man's quest for the basic things in life. Over the centuries those weapons ranged from bow and arrows to armor, swords and chain mail. But one technological development left them all behind - the invention of gunpowder. Since then, the advances in weaponry have been both awe-inspiring, and frightening.

programme.title: Helicopter Warfare
programme.desc: In the Iraq War, flying in the desert poses unique difficulties - the dust storm that accompanies every landing and take-off - and the lack of places to hide. When a young Royal Navy pilot comes under fire from a tank, he soon finds himself engaged in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Dawns Here are Quiet (English Version)
programme.desc: It is late spring of 1942, and World War 2 is in full swing. A long way off from the front-line the Germans make an air landing operation in an attempt to get through to the Kirov railway and the White Sea - Baltic Sea Canal. The only obstacle in their way is an anti-aircraft artillery unit of corporal Vaskov and five young women in training.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Speeding behind German lines the men of Troop A, in their armored cars and half-tracks left destruction and fear in their wake. Surprising the German garrison at the town of Epernay, they established an outpost from which they could defend a counter-attack. Outnumbered and outgunned with thirteen rounds of ammunition left, these brave GI's held this vital town until re-enforcements could arrive.

programme.title: After Hitler
programme.desc: May 1945: At last the Nazi shadow is lifting...War has devastated the continent, and now everyone just wants to get back to living again... But though the guns are now quiet, the Second World War isn't over yet. The Third Reich may have surrendered but the violence just won't seem to end.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Even the Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Will an investigation into these so-called silent early years reveal that Jesus was aware of His own divinity . . . even as a child? Why is the record of most of His life missing? Are the so-called silent early years of Jesus really lost? Or has the truth never been told? The answers you'll find here may surprise you!

programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: Joseph interprets a dream for Pharaoh and is then put in charge of the whole of Egypt.

programme.title: The Fourth Wiseman
programme.desc: Based on Henry van Dyke's classic, The Story of the Other Wise Man, this fictional story set in Biblical times is told in gently comic terms. A Magi named Artaban (Martin Sheen) sees a sign in the heavens that he hopes will lead him to the Messiah. Artaban takes with him three precious gifts to present to the Messiah. For 33 years Artaban pursues Jesus, only to miss Him at every turn.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: In 1917, two little girls and one small boy claimed to see and hear the Virgin Mary near Fatima, Portugal. What did the Fatima children witness? Learn the surprising answers.
programme.sub-title: Apparition of Mary: Was There a Miracle at Fatima?

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: The Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Are these silent early years of Jesus really lost? The answers may surprise you!
programme.sub-title: Jesus' Silent Years: Where Was Jesus All Those Years?

programme.title: The Case for Christ
programme.desc: Lee Strobel's blockbuster bestseller comes alive on your screen in this documentary that chronicles the reporter's journey from atheism to faith. The former legal editor of the Chicago Tribune draws upon his investigative skills to examine the historical viability and accuracy of the Gospels, along with the personal claims and resurrection of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Third Day
programme.desc: On the third day after Jesus' crucifixion, eyewitnesses reported that they found an empty tomb and had an encounter with a living, breathing Jesus of Nazareth. What proof do we have that the resurrection really happened? This intriguing documentary digs deep into the biblical and historical accounts and explores these questions: Did the disciples steal the body?

programme.title: Twelve Ordinary Men
programme.desc: A look at the twelve disciples who were hand-picked by Jesus to learn from his teachings, and spread the gospel after his crucifixion. Why these men?

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: St Peter's Basilica in Rome is the centre of the Roman Catholic faith. But the man who it is named after, knew nothing but fishing for the first part of his life. Following the death and resurrection of Jesus, Peter became a missionary of the Christian Church. From the shores of the Sea of Galilee to the might of Rome, Peter became one of the young churches first missionaries.

programme.title: Jesus The Desire Of Ages
programme.desc: Jesus: The Desire of Ages tells the familiar story in a fresh way, through the eyes of those who knew and loved the Son of Man. An inspiring and triumphant music score combined with imaginative visual artistry will grip your heart as you experience the reality of Jesus' ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: John was called by Jesus from the shores of the Sea of Galilee to come and follow him. For 3 years he was one of the inner-band of disciples, witnessing the transfiguration. After the death of Jesus, he was first at the tomb to discover that Jesus had risen. He became leader of the church at Ephesus where he wrote the Gospel of John. In the mines of Patmos, he had a wonderful vision of God.

programme.title: Mystery of the Shroud
programme.desc: In a tomb located in Jerusalem's Hell Valley, on land bought with Judas Iscariot's bloodstained silver, a sensational discovery was made. Vital information has been uncovered to paint a picture of what Jesus' grave would have looked like and what his burial process involved. One of the key moments in Christian history is made real and contemporary through this exciting archaeological discovery.

programme.title: Discovering Apostle Paul
programme.desc: Paul's background gave him a good understanding of Greek culture and philosophies. But to him the Gospel wasn't philosophy, it was truth and unlike the monasteries of Meteora, where monks hid their faith away, Paul engaged with the philosophers of his day in the market place. In Athens he was invited to address the Council of the Areopagus about the resurrection and 'Unknown God'.

programme.title: Jeremy's Egg
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jeremy is terminally ill and the only special-needs child in second grade. One day his teacher gives her students plastic eggs with the instructions to fill them with something that symbolizes Easter and new life.

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: From very early on, Mary was given the title 'Apostle of the Apostles'. We follow her career as a close follower of Jesus and, contrary to popular belief, show how she is a role model for the Christian life and a powerful feminist voice.

programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: The Gospels include eight pre-resurrection accounts concerning Jesus' power over nature.
programme.sub-title: The Temptation of Christ in the Wilderness

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: Judas has been the symbol of evil and treachery but does he deserve this reputation? Why has he continued to fascinate writers, actors and artists? It is time to re-examine his role in the Jesus story and in the centuries that followed.

programme.title: Third Day

What proof do we have that the resurrection really happened? This intriguing documentary digs deep into the biblical and historical accounts and explores these questions: Did the disciples steal the body?

programme.desc: In a tomb located in Jerusalem's Hell Valley, on land bought with Judas Iscariot's bloodstained silver, a sensational discovery was made. Vital information has been uncovered to paint a picture of what Jesus' grave would have looked like and what his burial process involved. One of the key moments in Christian history is made real and contemporary through this exciting archaeological discovery.

programme.title: Herod's Temple: The Temple Jesus Knew
programme.desc: Jerusalem, rich in historical and Biblical heritage, is the home of the Temple Mount, one of the world's most recognizable and visited sacred sites. Now, travel back in time to see it the way Jesus and his disciples did over 2,000 years ago. They knew it as Herod's Temple. We remember it as the Temple Jesus knew.

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World
programme.desc: The resurrection happened. It's not just the belief of Christians, it's borne out by history, archaeology, and science. This documentary takes viewers step by step through the events of Holy Week-shedding light on the key players, unraveling the political intrigue, and answering long standing questions about what happened, and why. Professor of ancient history and world-renowned expert Dr. Paul L.

programme.title: Jeremy's Egg
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jeremy is terminally ill and the only special-needs child in second grade. One day his teacher gives her students plastic eggs with the instructions to fill them with something that symbolizes Easter and new life.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: James and Jude were the brothers of Jesus, who like Jesus, grew up in their father's carpenters shop in Nazareth. It was only after Jesus' death and resurrection that they became his followers, with James heading up the Jerusalem Church. programme.desc: Three chefs compete in the heat for the central region. programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are pulling out all the stops. Marianne pays tribute to the `angels' in her local hospital who looked after her during a recent illness, and Ryan's dish is a reference to the purported health benefits of fish high in omega 3 oils, while Sabrina is inspired by her aunt, a retired nurse who used to take in food to share with her fellow workers during her shifts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and, following the previous day's results, tension is high. Both Marianne and Ryan are cooking muntjac in the hope of impressing the veteran judge, while Sabrina is making an ambitious technical take on a family feast.

programme.desc: With one dish left to impress the veteran judge, the chefs cook their desserts. Marianne is looking to raise a smile with her 'carry on' themed dessert, complete with surprise presentation. Sabrina hopes to make it through with an elevated take on jelly and ice cream while Ryan goes all out with his very sweet treat 'A Spoonful of Sugar'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining central region chefs do battle for a place in the national finals. They must impress the formidable panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton with their four-course menus.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andrew is attempting to pay tribute to NHS staff with his take on a traditional healing recipe, 'Mum's Flu-Fighting Chicken Soup'. Jason's 'A Tea From The Heart' is a play on a post-war remedy which harks back to the era when the NHS was formed.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After the starter results, the chefs return to the kitchen hoping for high scores with their fish dishes. Chris once again is using ingredients he has foraged from around his restaurant, while Jason hopes to impress with a spicy scallop dish and Andrew prepares a cod dish with 11 different elements.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are pulling out all the stops in a bid for big scores with their mains. programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and the last opportunity for the chefs to impress. Which two will make it through to the judging chamber?

Who will win a place in the national finals?

programme.desc: It's the turn of three chefs representing the south-west, including two who have competed before but meet in the kitchen this week for the very first time. The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their celebratory starters.

Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second-busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

programme.desc: With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

programme.desc: Cici Flowers is an exotic dancer with a sordid past. She meets Julius, who is in an rocky relationship with his long-time girlfriend. Cici flees to live with her cousin and meets Julius's girlfriend. When Cici and Julius connect, sparks begin to fly, causing a sordid love triangle between the three.. Who will come out on top?

programme.title: The Queens Ball
programme.desc: Racine Robinson is the queen pin of a criminal empire, alongside her daughters Cand and Kat. Racine is celebrating her 50th birthday and invited all the regional crime families to come and celebrate. Unbeknownst to her, a contract has been taking out to kil Racine on her birthday. With government intervention, and various talking heads, the death of Racine could lead to open warfare in the city.

programme.title: When Girls Ride
programme.desc: When Samantha leaves the South to have a fresh start with her husband, she ends up meeting two biker girls named Raquel and Tammy. The three women grow close, and decide to start their own women's bike club. Things take a turn for the worse when they lose a girl from their group to violence. The women respond accordingly in order to get justice for their friend.

programme.title: Mother of a Day
programme.desc: A man who forgets his wedding anniversary angers one woman. Imagine angering four of the most important women in your life on the same day! That's what happens when one man does something unthinkable and seemingly unforgivable ...HE FORGETS MOTHER'S DAY! Ben Wilson has one hour to sneak out of his house and find adequate gifts for the four moms in his life - his wife Mary, daughter Abby, mother Ruth and mother-in-law Mother Dunbar - or face their wrath!

programme.title: Smash and Dash
programme.desc: Clarence, a Chef from Chicago, is very passionate about two things, food and love. After being jilted at the altar, Clarence's friends Lakeith and Buddy, immediately urge him to get back into the dating pool, but under one condition, and that is for him to "Smash and Dash." Clarence needs to hook up with as many women as he possibly can through a dating app without falling in love.

programme.title: Fall Semester
programme.desc: Kid Kypree is a college student with dreams and ambitions of becoming the next great stand-up comic. One night he gets invited to a party hosted by his old friend Bo that thrusts him into a whirlwind of opportunities and challenges that will test his friendships, resolve, and his sense of humor. He will soon discover that success comes with its own set of comedic twists and turns!

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert, but is hindered by her reckless mother Shonte. When the opportunity arises for both her and her mother to go, they're surprised to find out they have been invited to meet and greet with her favorite artist. What would be a dream of joy, quickly turns into a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Black Game Night
programme.desc: A group of friends prepare to attend The Blacks' annual game night, but make a chilling discovery when the arrive to find the hosts have been brutally murdered. In their pursuit to uncover the murderer, secrets unravel and betrayals are discovered, winning no longer becomes the goal - it's surviving.

programme.title: Meli
programme.desc: After finding an eviction notice on her door, Meli decides it's time to up the ante and take matters into her own hands to protect her family by any means necessary. Out of pure desperation she attempts to burglarize a stranger's luxurious home.

programme.title: When Love Comes Knocking
programme.desc: Veronica Richardson, a girl who has never been with a good man, is caught off guard when true love finds its way to her doorstep. It is up to her if she wants to let it in or shut it out. Damaged and heartbroken from a past childhood friend, Veronica had lost all hope to ever be able to love again.

programme.title: And They Named Her Love
programme.desc: Love, a hopeless romantic painter, sets out on a cross country journey to find herself in the competitive world of artistry. When a near death experience brings Atlanta based songstress Nasada into her life, she goes on a journey to find out that love and business do not always mix.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Christmas
programme.desc: An entire family has lost faith in Christmas, and everything that comes with it, until the youngest in the family reminds them all that the spirit of Christmas is more than just giving and receiving presents.

programme.title: Endless Summer
programme.desc: Keith has spent his whole life dreaming about Alicia. On his last day in town he tries desperately to be noticed by her, but his plans get foiled by his embarrassing grandmother, bullying sister, demanding father, and Alicia's 'player' boyfriend.

programme.title: Street Tales of Terror
programme.desc: Street Tales of Terror is the Story of three killer thugs: J Dog, Keith and Peaches who terrorize a homeless man who witnessed them commit murder. While pleading for his life, the homeless man tells the trio of three "true" tales of terror and revenge."The Reckoning" follows the story of Jessica, a little girl who is left to drown on dry land by her classmates after she is pushed into a swimming pool. On her birthday twenty years later, Jessica comes back to settle the score!

programme.title: Secure the Bag 2
programme.desc: Greed is Lit's first love. Lit lost his uncle, who practically raised him, over money he stole from bank robbers. Lit decides to go back to the house where he lost his uncle, but Lit is hiding a secret. It wasn't just money he found.

programme.title: Last Words
programme.desc: For years Tiffany has been wanting to leave her relationship, but she is terrified on how her abusive boyfriend Mike will react. Money and stress seem to be the backbone for Mike behaving so abusively towards her. With one year left in school, Tiffany contemplates on running away from her pain and struggling relationship forever.

programme.title: Pearl 2
programme.desc: Travis continues his life of sobriety and is at a place in life where he is looking for a companion. He soon realizes that some things from his past don't just go away because you want them to. Travis' dad struggles with his own demons from his past and turns to an unlikely means of dealing with them. Jeremy and Ray must find a way to work together if they want their business to continue to grow. However a looming secret threatens to upend everything.

programme.title: Hard Lesson
programme.desc: A Jewish parole officer, Jeff Solomon White, struggles in his new role as a reading teacher for illiterate teens at a New York high school. Raised by African American parents, White sees the situation differently and is motivated to fight for his students, who face an almost certain life of crime and prison.

programme.title: The Lies We Tell But the Secrets We Keep: Sweet Revenge
programme.desc: Bri is on life support fighting for her life, while Roni is trying to find Tank, to seek revenge, and take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: Too Little Too Late
programme.desc: James "Honcho" Young II is a well-respected boss but his position is threatened by his ex-love, turned partner, Ryan "Rain" Mills who desperately wants to be next in line. programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire uncovers a long-lost treasure which brings back memories of her mother and unleashes a fear that she will also die in childbirth. Tess organises a fake séance to try to ease Claire's fears and there are some surprising results.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost of Things to Come

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The joy surrounding Harry and Liz's 30th wedding anniversary is shattered when Harry's nagging suspicions about Alex not being the father of Claire's baby explodes into a fit of rage after an innocent remark leads to Liz confessing a long-held secret.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Relations between Alex and his father take another turn for the worse when Alex discovers he has been cut off financially. Nick tries to play peacemaker but both sides are stubborn and his efforts go unappreciated.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Anticipation is high as Tess's journalist friend is due to arrive at Drovers Run to write a feature magazine article about life on the land. However, tensions between her and Tess begin to rise as old wounds are reopened and long-forgotten feelings are revisited.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky feels betrayed when she learns Jake's true identity from his father at the auctions. Jodi discovers the real reason Kylie left home when she goes through Kylie's mail. A pending court date for a shoplifting charge is rapidly approaching but Kylie seems willing to ignore it.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex, especially when Sandra Kinsella appears on the scene.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Jodi receives a mysterious chain letter, she discards it immediately. The scattered pieces of the letter have barely hit the compost when Becky announces that the cattle are sick. Further misfortune soon strikes Drovers Run, with Terry falling ill and the discovery of a dead sheep.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick and Alex must face the awful truth of their father's new girlfriend while they argue over Harry's proposal for a stock route through Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Tess stubbornly refuses to ask for outside help to shear her alpacas, insisting on doing the job herself.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Mysterious lights are seen by Claire and Tess over Drovers Run. Tess is determined to believe they are a good omen, but Claire, restless and uneasy in the last stages of pregnancy, insists that trouble awaits.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter. The chaotic situation is just one more stress for Claire who is struggling to balance the demands of motherhood with that of running the ranch.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire is having a naming ceremony for Charlotte Prudence McLeod with her friends and family when Peter arrives. Claire has written to him after the birth, telling him he is a father. Peter is justifiably angry.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Determined to prove herself during a Fire Service training weekend, Jodi quickly realises it's going to be far more difficult than she had anticipated. Meanwhile, Meg is dedicating herself to her studies and is thoroughly immersed in 'Pride and Prejudice'.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky and Jake join in a business partnership with Claire and Tess; Claire has issues with some of Jake's clients.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Alex and Nick come to the rescue of an attractive woman named Ellie when her car breaks down on a country road. Almost instantly they're pitched into a competition to woo her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Drovers Run is quarantined and the future of the stock placed under a cloud, true friends seem few and far between as Claire finally goes head-to-head with her old enemy Sandra Kinsella. Meg and Terry have their eye on a piece of land but are unable to come up with the deposit, until an offer of help comes from an unlikely person.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire's role as spokesperson for the local farmers' association requires her to visit Melbourne. Alex is insistent that he come along to look after them while also pursuing some Wilgul matters, but the real reason is that he wants to meet his biological father.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire and Alex are still in Melbourne, blissfully in love. At Drovers, Tess and Dave are making plans for their wedding day. When Tess, in the shower, discovers a lump in her breast, she fears she will share her mother's fate and quickly goes into denial, telling no-one.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess and Dave split up when they realise that he has not yet come to terms with the death of his wife. Meanwhile, prompted by Becky, Claire asks Harry if she can use King Harold in a new breeding program on Drovers.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Drovers Run hosts the Regional Young Farmer of the Year Contest, and Becky is surprised to learn that Jake has entered. He tells her he's going to win her back. They compete neck and neck and slowly Becky is won over by his persistence and charm, and the old spark between them returns.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess's upcoming operation has thoughts of mortality creeping in, so she begins to write a letter to Charlotte so that her niece can know her, should Tess no longer be around. Meanwhile, Claire reminisces when an old friend turns up unexpectedly.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Heartbreak hits Drovers Run. Tess anxiously awaits the results of her breast cancer tests, convinced that her time is up, while Alex and Claire decide to move in together.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire's death has everyone dealing with it in their own way. Tess tries to keep her emotions in check, unable to deal with her grief and burdened by survivor's guilt. Terry, Jodi, and Meg are left with the task of running Drovers Run and dealing with funeral arrangements.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess and Stevie continue to clash and all the ill-feelings come to the surface when a private investigator turns up. Tess accepts Stevie's explanations at first but gets suspicious when Stevie is caught packing her bags.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Six months after Claire's death, Tess has thrown herself into her work. She wants to assure Charlotte's future, as well as remain faithful to Claire's dream for Drovers. Bushfires sweep through the area and Tess has to face it alone until Stevie turns up to fight by her side.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie agrees to do a seemingly simple favour for Sandra to repay her for not pressing charges for stealing her plane. To get out of Sandra's scheme, Tess takes a big gamble, confident she can defeat Sandra in a winner takes all poker game.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess is surprised in the middle of the night by a stranger named Jack Blake who knocks at the door looking for Jack McLeod... his father. Tess's mind is spinning with the possibility of a new member of the family - something she is lacking after Claire's death.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Brad Whittaker, the new Stock, and Station agent make a good first impression on the women of Drovers Run, but things quickly go downhill from there. Sandra has a surprising solution when Alex and Nick face a heart-wrenching decision

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie's first encounter with fallen rodeo champion Ken Logan occurs when she stops off at his garage for petrol. When Ken later collapses at work, he leaves Stevie with a cryptic message, believing she is his estranged daughter.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick and Tess's relationship, or at least what remains of it, is further tested when she discovers that Nick and Alex have started an intensive farming operation and have dammed off the creek.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess, forcing her to re-evaluate her stance in the custody battle with Peter, and leading her to a difficult decision about Charlotte's future. Meanwhile, Harry and Sandra have a surprise for Alex and Nick.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.
